exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: Are you happy to be the age you are now? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: When you were a child, did you think a lot about your future? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: Do you think you have changed as you have got older? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: What will be different about your life in the future? [Why]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a time when you started using a new technological device (e.g. a new computer or phone). You should say: what device you started using why you started using this device how easy or difficult it was to use and explain how helpful this device was to you.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: What is the best age for children to start computer lessons?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Do you think that schools should use more technology to help children learn?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Do you agree or disagree that computers will replace teachers one day?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: How much has technology improved how we communicate with each other?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Do you agree that there are still many more major technological innovations to be made?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Could you suggest some reasons why some people are deciding to reduce their use of technology?
